full_prompt_en: A square romantic oil portrait shows a young man in a rust-red coat turning toward the viewer against a deep brown woodland-like background. The ground is dark and textured, with indistinct vertical trunks and warm rubbed foliage behind the head. The figure occupies most of the left and central frame, seated or leaning with one shoulder advanced toward the right. Thick wavy brown hair rises above the forehead, its lighter tips catching the illumination. His pale face turns toward the viewer from a three-quarter angle, with steady blue-gray eyes, a straight nose, and tightly closed lips. Warm peach and cool gray brushwork model the cheekbones and jaw, giving the expression a serious, self-possessed quality. A high white collar wraps close to the neck over dark inner clothing, and a loose rust-red coat falls across the shoulders and chest. Its lapels and folds are built from dense reddish-brown strokes with brighter copper touches along raised edges. One arm extends toward the lower-right boundary, while the rest of the body sinks into deep shadow near the bottom. The background's brown and olive marks remain soft and indistinct, making the face and pale collar the clearest surfaces. Fine brushwork defines hair, eyes, and features, but the coat and setting show broader, more energetic paint. Light arrives from the upper left and front, striking the face and collar before tapering across the coat; the far edge dissolves into shadow without a hard cast silhouette. The overall composition is close and dramatic, using luminous flesh and a warm red garment against near-black earth color to hold the quiet gaze.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形浪漫主义油画肖像呈现一位穿铁锈红外套的年轻男子，在深棕色、似林地的背景前转向观者。底面深暗且有肌理，头后有模糊竖向树干和暖色擦出的树叶。人物占据左侧与中央大部分，坐着或倚靠着，一侧肩膀向右前方伸出。厚厚的棕色波浪发从额头上方隆起，较浅的发梢接住光。浅色面孔从四分之三角度转向观者，有稳定的蓝灰眼睛、直鼻和紧闭嘴唇。暖桃色与冷灰色笔触塑造颧骨和下颌，使神情显得严肃而自持。高高的白色领子贴着颈部，盖在深色内衣上，宽松的铁锈红外套则落在肩胸。翻领和褶皱由浓密的红褐笔触构成，隆起边缘有更亮的铜色重音。一只手臂向右下边缘伸出，身体其余部分在底部沉进深影。背景棕色与橄榄色笔迹保持柔和模糊，让脸和浅色领子成为最清楚的表面。精细笔触界定头发、眼睛和五官，外套与环境则采用更宽、更有力的颜料。光从左前上方进入，照到脸和领子，然后在外套上逐渐减弱；远侧边缘溶入阴影，没有硬剪影。整体构图贴近而戏剧性，以发亮肤色和暖红衣服立在近黑土色前，承载安静的目光。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting combines finely modeled pale focal planes with broader restless strokes in surrounding dark masses. Rust red, copper, warm umber, olive-black, ivory, and cool gray create a concentrated palette whose brightest areas gather near the upper center. Hairlike and clothlike textures are suggested by directional paint rather than exhaustive detail; the ground remains rubbed and atmospheric. Edges sharpen around the focal features and light collar, then soften where the large dark forms meet the background. High front-side light gives skinlike planes volume and allows warm shadow to deepen without losing color. A close three-quarter arrangement and diagonal lower mass lend quiet movement to an otherwise still composition. The overall effect is serious and romantic, with contrast between controlled modeling and loose painterly darkness.
style_prompt_zh: 油画把细心塑形的浅色焦点平面与周围深色体块里更宽、更不安定的笔触结合起来。铁锈红、铜色、暖深棕、橄榄黑、象牙白和冷灰组成集中的色域，最亮处聚在上部中央附近。头发般与衣料般肌理由有方向的颜料提示，而非穷尽细节；底面保持擦出的空气感。焦点五官和浅色衣领周围边缘变锐，大片暗形与背景相接处则柔化。高处侧前光赋予肤质般平面体积，也让暖影加深却不丢色彩。近距离四分之三式排列和下方斜向体块，为原本静止的构图添一点安静运动。整体效果严肃而浪漫，受控塑形与松散绘画黑暗之间的对照构成画风。
theme_en: A young man in a rust-red coat turning toward the viewer
theme_zh: 一位穿铁锈红外套的年轻男子转向观者
name: Theodore Chasseriau
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
